args.description: in mid-air, sweeps one open hand up in an arc over his head, then back to the tucked pose; nothing leaves his body, his hands stay empty. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy black hair and violet eyes, a long black coat with a ragged violet lining worn open over a dark shirt, black trousers and black boots
args.initial_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked
